SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_INVALID_FUNC_LEN.desc: A locator configured with invalid func_len

SRV6_MY_LOCATOR_INVALID_VRF.desc: A locator configured with an invalid VRF name

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_LOCATOR.desc: A SID configured with invalid locator identifier

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_IP_PREFIX.desc: A SID configured with invalid IPv6 address

SRV6_MY_SID_INVALID_ACTION.desc: A SID with action uA but missing interface (must constraint)
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_INTERFACE.desc: A SID configured with action uA but missing interface
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_ADJ.desc: Valid config with action uA (adj is optional)

SRV6_MY_SID_UA_MISSING_BOTH.desc: A SID configured with action uA but missing both interface and adj
eStr: interface is mandatory when action is 'uA'

SRV6_MY_SID_ADJ_INVALID_ACTION.desc: A SID with adj set but action is not uA
eStr: adj is only applicable when action is 'uA'

SRV6_SOURCE_CANONICAL.desc: Accept the canonical SRv6 source singleton.

SRV6_SOURCE_LEGACY_KEY.desc: Preserve a single existing SRv6 source key.

SRV6_SOURCE_MULTIPLE.desc: Reject competing global SRv6 source rows.

SRV6_SOURCE_MISSING_ADDRESS.desc: Require an address for an SRv6 source row.

SRV6_LOCATOR_PREFIX_CIDR.desc: Accept a locator prefix with its explicit compatible length.

SRV6_LOCATOR_PREFIX_GEOMETRY_MISMATCH.desc: Reject a prefix length inconsistent with block plus node.
eStr: locator prefix length must equal block_len plus node_len

SRV6_LOCATOR_F3216.desc: Accept explicit F3216 with compatible implicit geometry.

SRV6_LOCATOR_F3216_REQUIRES_USID.desc: Require explicit uSID behavior for F3216.
eStr: usid-f3216 requires behavior usid and geometry 32/16/16/0

SRV6_LOCATOR_F3216_BAD_GEOMETRY.desc: Reject geometry that F3216 would override.
eStr: usid-f3216 requires behavior usid and geometry 32/16/16/0

SRV6_ISIS_BINDING.desc: Accept the default-instance locator and existing interface binding.

SRV6_ISIS_MISSING_LOCATOR.desc: Reject an absent IS-IS locator reference.

SRV6_ISIS_MISSING_INTERFACE.desc: Reject an absent IS-IS SRv6 interface reference.

SRV6_ISIS_LOCATOR_INTERFACE_PAIR.desc: Require a locator for an explicit SRv6 interface.
eStr: IS-IS SRv6 requires locator and interface in the default VRF

SRV6_ISIS_INTERFACE_LOCATOR_PAIR.desc: Require an explicit existing interface for the locator.
eStr: IS-IS SRv6 requires locator and interface in the default VRF

SRV6_ISIS_NONDEFAULT_BINDING.desc: Reject a new SRv6 binding outside the supported default VRF.
eStr: IS-IS SRv6 requires locator and interface in the default VRF

SRV6_DUPLICATE_ACTION_PREFIX.desc: Reject multiple action-bearing rows with one native SID prefix.
eStr: action-bearing SID prefixes must be unique across locators

SRV6_SHARED_PREFIX_POLICY_ONLY.desc: Allow policy-only rows to share a prefix across locators.
